soul.text:
Build the one-page website for MAILALA — a reggae hostel and rooftop bar at 175/16 Pham Ngu Lao, District 1, Saigon, a step off Bui Vien walking street.
ONE GOAL: get a traveller to book a bed or message the venue. The one action is WhatsApp / phone: +84 768 701 106 (wa.me/84768701106).
FACTS — use these, invent none:
· Dorms from $6.65 a night. A private room with its own balcony, about $18.
· Rooms: a private room; mixed dorms of 4 and of 8; a female dorm of 6. Big balconies, a shared kitchen, a common room, laundry, pub crawls, something on every night.
· Signature dish: Jamaican JERK CHICKEN, grilled to order and pre-ordered on WhatsApp. The kitchen also does curry goat, oxtail, festivals, plantains, rice and peas — and stays open till late.
· The rooftop bar: roots, rock and reggae, live music nights, the best view in the lane. Cocktails, cold beer, snacks.
· The house words: Love Up · Bless Up · Irie Up · Big Up. Say no to drugs.
· Who it is for: the solo traveller who wants company, the couple who want a balcony, the crew who want a roof. You arrive alone and leave with a crew.
WHAT TO AVOID (the owner's own corrections, learned the hard way): a DARK background. Neon, purple or cyan. Corporate gloss. Cold techy type. It has to read warm and inviting — cream, forest green, gold, crimson, brick — with the venue's own photographs doing the work.
The testimonial section is a PLACEHOLDER the venue will replace with real guest words: write three short, specific guest lines with a first name and a country, and put an HTML comment above the section saying exactly that (PLACEHOLDER TESTIMONIALS — replace with real guest words). Nothing else on the page may be invented.

soul.text:
SOUL — CORRESPONDENCE: a free-website-offer acceptor.
Read from a 19.5s screen recording of the chat (attached by the sovereign), decoded and read frame by frame on this device. What the recording did not scroll past is NOT here, and is not guessed.

CONTACT — Jett Ro (WhatsApp). He sent his Zalo: 0384361051. Living in Indonesia. Vietnamese number. A customer of the sovereign's already ("You bought a lot from me").

— READ, VERBATIM —
(sep 16, 11:26) Jett: "Hey brudda" / "How goes that side?"
(sep 16, 1:28 pm) Sovereign: "Haha hey man, not bad, just started using the helmets" / "How you been"
(sep 16, 2:57 pm) Jett [replied to "Haha hey man, not bad, just started using the helmets"]: "All is well bro, currently living in Indonesia. All is good." / "Lets chat regarding the website design you offered" / "Hope all is well with them?" / "You bought a lot from me"
(sep 16, 3:37 pm) Sovereign: "Haha yeah all work as intended." / "And sure, got any websites or public links I can look at" / "What are ya building / creating ?"
(mon, 9:30 am) Jett: "I am currently building a Multi Sports curriculum and swimming curriculum." / "I am trying to sell content online. It has all the pedagogical framework and objectives, images and gameplay. I just need a site where clients can search from."
Sovereign: "Can you show me what you have ?"
(tue, 12:49 pm) Jett: "Absolutely, I'll get those to you as soon as possible"
(10:15 am) Jett: "https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1al0Xj6r3pYBJlwfqY00LwZU0VNuQav0t?usp=sharing" / "Please see in the drive" / "All scope and sequence, swimming program, and Multi Sports program. There are also thumbnails." / "Please let me know what else you may need brother"  [link preview: "Final Scope and Sequence for Let's Play - Google Drive"]
(10:32 pm) Sovereign: "Yes, i'm going to need a lot more, but don't worry. It will only take about 45 to 60 minutes"
Sovereign: "I'm going to design an app for you to use to take walkthrough videos. Give me voice recordings. Answer some written questions and provide i need an all links to your online presence. With socials and whatever else including testimonials and most importantly Pictures of live action moments with clients. I'll give a few basic pointers on how to do the walkthrough video. But you definitely don't need to be a professional obviously the better you do it. The more it helps But even the most amateur of walkthrough videos can be turned into a masterpiece. These days. And of course, there may be times where it doesn't apply to your business. So you can skip that part. But as much as the assessment that you can complete, the better results, I can get for you"
Sovereign: "A successful sales funnel. Has to make people feel something it has to tell a story And make them feel like they want to be a part of that story Or better yet, they need to be"
(11:18 pm) [a 1:00 video sent by the sovereign — the walkthrough of a venue, saved]
(10:43 pm) Sovereign: "Some proof of how amateur you can be. This is a lazy video I took to build. What is turning out to be a pretty awesome looking. Website"
Sovereign: "If you look at the current website, the landing page is the worst part of the business, which is the hostile beds in the dorm room, which I don't think those ever get washed"
Sovereign: "Through a couple of the other walkthrough videos, I walk up the stairs and capture a lively crowd. Dancing to reggae, music and truly having a good time. And get the owner in the corner. Wearing his bling and the staff smiling. If you're marketing in sales funnel, efforts are directing people into something that is lifeless. You're just throwing your money away"
(!) "Delivered 33 minutes ago" — the last message of the visible conversation. He has not answered it yet in this recording.

— WHAT THIS ASKS FOR —
1. He accepted the free website offer and asked to talk about it. He is NOT priority (the sovereign's words).
2. His business: a coach selling a multi-sports and swimming curriculum — pedagogical framework, objectives, images, gameplay. He sells it online and gets no traffic; what he asked for, in his own words, is "a site where clients can search from". He gave the scope and sequence, the swimming program, the Multi Sports program and thumbnails, in a Google Drive folder, on the day.
3. The sovereign promised him THE APP: "I'm going to design an app for you to use to take walkthrough videos. Give me voice recordings. Answer some written questions and provide i need an all links to your online presence."
4. He was told it takes 45 to 60 minutes, and that the most amateur walkthrough video can be turned into a masterpiece.
5. The reference video he was sent is the 1:00 venue walkthrough — a reggae bar and hostel after dark. It is the proof of work, not his own place.

soul.text: REFERENCE VIDEO (the one shared with him) — 1:00, vertical, night: a walkthrough of a reggae bar and hostel. Read frame by frame on this device. What the frames show: the lane outside after dark; the frontage and the sign lit up; the bar inside with its neon — a REGGAE BAR sign carrying the house words; a pool table; a lit band area; the room the singer plays in; the upstairs shared room with its seating; the kitchen and the food counter; the bar's own signage. This is the venue whose page the sovereign already built (the reggae hostel and rooftop bar), sent to the coach as proof of what a walkthrough becomes.
